text:
Ana K: Quick update — we changed swag to a postcard + QR micro-giveaway for tonight's Sunset Salon. Saves table space and shipping. Need routing for: postcard table, bag-drop, and lead handoff.
Mike L: got it. how many postcards and where are they stored? :point_up:
Sophie R: I ordered 250 postcards, printer confirmed delivery by 17:45 to lobby table. I'll bring the badge ribbons and a small tote.
Ana K: perfect. plan: 2 people at table (sign & scan), 1 floater who roams to talk and hand off to slate, 1 person doing final bag-drop back at office. Jared can you own slate handoff + QR scanner?
Jared T: yep I can do slate/QR. do we have a short staff script? make it uniform please.
Mike L: drafting script now — will post.
Mike L: Script v1:
```
1) Greet: "Hi! We're Redwood Inference — quick demo in 2 mins?"
2) Ask: "Are you building with LLMs or exploring infra?"
3) Scan: "Can I grab your email to send the one-pager?" (scan QR)
4) Tag: add `salon-sunset` to notes
5) Close: hand postcard + say "we'll follow up with benchmarks + trial credits"
```
Sophie R: minor tweak: if they say "no", just drop postcard and ask permission to email. keeps it polite. :white_check_mark:
Ana K: routing: table is at booth B7 by the west stairs. tote with postcards and sharpies in the green courier bag (Ops left it by conf storage). Jared — you'll carry the iPad + portable scanner (code: REDWOOD-QR).
Jared T: scanner battery tested. iPad offline cache set up. Scanner points to sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEFghIJKlmnOPQ (read-only link for staff)
marketing-bot: Inventory update — postcards reserved: 250, handed to Sophie at 17:40. Reminder: update `swag-inventory` before end of night.
Mike L: Lead routing: use spreadsheet zap to HubSpot. Tag = `salon-sunset-2024`. UTM param for QR = `?utm_campaign=salon-sunset-2024&utm_source=postcard`. Jared make sure scanners append utm if possible.
Jared T: confirmed zap endpoint set. did a dry run with my phone: row created, HubSpot contact created with tag.
Sophie R: packing & handoff timeline: 17:30 — load postcards into green bag; 17:45 — drop to west stairs table; 18:00 — staff briefing by Ana at booth; 18:15 — doors open.
Ana K: staff briefing checklist (short):
- roles (table1, table2, floater, slate)
- quick script
- escalate to Ops for lost bag (call @mike on cell)
- note sticker color: "postcard" = blue dot on attendee list
Mike L: i'll make a one-slide script + QR image for staff Slack channel. Also: pls keep 10 extras for speakers.
Sophie R: speaker extras noted. I'm also leaving envelopes for follow-up postcards (for partners).
Ana K: follow-ups: everyone add 1 example note to the sheet if you talk to an attendee who mentions "inference costs" or "private deployment" so we can route to Solutions. Tag names: `costs`, `private-deploy`.
Jared T: on it. will add a quick dropdown column to the sheet.
Mike L: last ask — after party pick-up: return green bag and any leftover postcards to 3rd floor ops closet by 23:30. If someone can't, @Sophie will courier next morning.
Sophie R: can handle courier next morning if needed.
Ana K: thanks team — short, clean flow. ping me if anything breaks tonight. :pray:
